question: Who among the following Navratnas from Chandragupta II court wrote 'Mantrashastra'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vetala Bhatta.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Navratnas**:-

 
 
• These were the nine gems (scholars and poets) in the court of Chandragupta II, who was a ruler of the Gupta dynasty in India.
 
 
 
• **Mantrashastra:-**
 
 
• It is a treatise on statecraft, diplomacy, and military strategy.
 
 
 
• **Vetala Bhatta:-**
 
 
• He was a renowned scholar and poet who was one of the Navratnas in the court of Chandragupta II.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalidasa:-**

 
 
• He was also a famous poet and playwright in the Gupta era, known for his works like 'Meghaduta', 'Abhijnanasakuntalam', and 'Raghuvamsa'.
 
 
 
• **Ghatakarapara**:-
 
 
• He was a minister in the court of Chandragupta II, known for his contributions to the field of astronomy.
 
 
 
• **Amarasimha:-**
 
 
• He was a lexicographer and grammarian, who wrote the famous Sanskrit dictionary 'Amarakosha'.
